summary: Continuation of a Python inventory script example that builds groups, hosts, children and _meta hostvars from a custom API and handles --list, --host and --pretty arguments.
questions: How do I write a dynamic inventory script in Python?
What should --host return if my script already provides _meta?

answer_card.title: Python inventory script example
answer_card.answer_md:
The Python example builds a dict with each group's `hosts`, `vars` and `children`, fills `_meta.hostvars` (setting `ansible_host` from an address when available), and prints `json.dumps(data)`.

It uses argparse with mutually exclusive `--list` and `--host`, plus `--pretty`. Because `--list` already returns `_meta`, `--host` just prints `{"_meta":{}}` and notes on stderr that the option is ignored.
